canonicalization: For each architecture, compare the complete Mach-O prefix before LC_CODE_SIGNATURE.dataoff. Before hashing, zero only __LINKEDIT vmsize/filesize and LC_CODE_SIGNATURE.datasize fields; require equal signature data offsets. This removes signature-size effects while retaining code, symbols, load commands and other content. Local universal inputs were split with lipo; only temporary copies were used.

upstreamSourceChain.conclusion: The release tag resolves to the pinned commit. A successful workflow run for that commit produced three artifacts whose SHA-256 values exactly match the corresponding GitHub Release assets. This proves the source commit to CI artifact to GitHub Release asset chain. The downloaded fat Release asset was locally hash-verified and its arm64 slices canonically match 38/44 locked workspace libraries; the versioned iina.io endpoint matches 43/44 locked workspace libraries. The two sources therefore have substantial binary correspondence, but are not the same exact build for every component, and the workflow does not publish the versioned endpoint. The single libavformat mismatch in the workspace is the intentional Bomu FFmpeg overlay; remaining non-overlay mismatches are unexplained build differences.
